Landed · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-27T06:59Z

PR #26505 merged at `48ee8b6d` (merged 2026-10-27T06:59Z). `48ee8b6d` is an ancestor of `origin/main`. On every path the PR touched, the merge tree matches the accepted head `e61d8355` byte for byte.

`os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` now report `manifest.dependencies` ranges at build time through the install's own predicate (`checkDeclaredDependencies`). An error is raised only where the install refuses: an unreadable out-of-artifact range, or a non-record `dependencies`. Everything the install admits is a warning, such as an in-artifact mismatch. The diagnostics use kebab-case codes (ADR-0112 D6c). The card closed through `Fixes #25793`, and this seat removes `pm:dispatched`.
